_comment: Soundboard script for tools/gen-audio.mjs. Original lines only: never the book's boxed text (the repo is public). A clip's file is assets/audio/<id>.mp3; delete it to regenerate. A voice with no id is skipped until it has one.

clips.label: SFX: commlink buzzing
clips.sfx: An old commlink buzzing and vibrating on a bedside table in a quiet dark apartment, insistent, three rings

clips.label: Read-aloud: the wake-up call
clips.text: Your commlink drags you out of a dead sleep. The clock says it's too early for anything good. The caller ID says Juan Diablo, and Diablo doesn't call to chat.

clips.label: Diablo: rise and shine
clips.text: Rise and shine, chummer. Got work, and it pays. Meet's in an hour.

clips.label: Diablo: don't be late
clips.text: Don't be late, and don't be stupid. This Johnson's got class.

clips.label: Diablo: I just make introductions
clips.text: Hey, I just make the introductions. What happens after that is on you.

clips.label: SFX: Harley idling
clips.sfx: A heavy motorcycle engine idling in a rain-wet parking lot at night, then revving once

clips.label: Read-aloud: the meet
clips.text: The car is long, black and spotless. The man in the back seat is the same: good suit, good manners, nothing you could describe to Lone Star tomorrow. He gestures to the seats across from him.

clips.label: Johnson: please, sit
clips.text: Thank you for coming on short notice. Please, sit.

clips.label: Johnson: the job
clips.text: The job is simple. A certain young lady must miss an appointment. Not permanently. Just long enough to be embarrassing.

clips.label: Johnson: nobody gets hurt
clips.text: Let me be clear. My client wants her inconvenienced, not damaged. Nobody gets hurt.

clips.label: Johnson: no questions
clips.text: Who my client is, and why, are not part of the arrangement. Do we have an arrangement?

playlists.name: QE Soundboard — Act 1: To Catch A Star

clips.label: SFX: Pacific Towers lobby (loop)
clips.sfx: Quiet upscale apartment lobby at night, soft elevator chimes, a fountain, distant city traffic through glass doors

clips.label: SFX: building alarm
clips.sfx: A building security alarm going off, loud electronic klaxon echoing through marble halls

clips.label: Rent-a-cop: can I help you?
clips.text: Evening. Can I, uh, help you? Residents and guests only past this point. I'll need to see some ID.

clips.label: Rent-a-cop: hey, you can't be in here
clips.text: Hey! Hey, you can't be in here! I'm calling this in, okay? Don't move!

clips.label: Rent-a-cop: panic button
clips.text: Oh drek, oh drek. Lobby to anyone! I've got armed people in the lobby! Send Lone Star!

clips.label: Knight Errant: step back
clips.text: Sir, step back from the vehicle. This area is restricted. I won't ask you twice.

clips.label: Knight Errant: contact!
clips.text: Contact, front entrance! Team two, cover the principal! Move, move!

clips.label: Knight Errant: man down
clips.text: Man down! I need a medic on the twentieth floor, now!

clips.label: Osprey: not receiving visitors
clips.text: I'm afraid Miss Euphoria isn't receiving visitors this evening. Do turn around, there's a good chap.

clips.label: Osprey: orders to Knight Errant
clips.text: Knight Errant, hold them at the door. Nobody gets past the hallway. I'll see to the young lady.

clips.label: Osprey: bad career move
clips.text: You've no idea who you're dealing with, have you? This was a very poor career decision.

clips.label: Stone: I'd stop there
clips.text: I'd stop there, if I were you. This room is warded.

clips.label: Stone: the spirit's waiting
clips.text: The fire spirit has been waiting all evening for someone to try something foolish. Go on.

clips.label: Stone: we're done here
clips.text: Osprey. We're outgunned. Get her clear, I'll cover the stairs.

clips.label: Euphoria: you can't be serious
clips.text: You can't be serious. Do you have any idea what my fans will do to you?

clips.label: Euphoria: Osprey, do something!
clips.text: Osprey! Osprey, do something! What are we paying you for?

clips.label: Lone Star: arriving
clips.text: Lone Star! Nobody move! Everybody on the floor, hands where I can see them!

clips.label: Lone Star: calling it in
clips.text: Dispatch, unit four-twelve at Pacific Towers. Shots fired, requesting backup.

playlists.name: QE Soundboard — Act 1: Holding Euphoria & Payday

clips.label: Read-aloud: the Royal Meadows flat
clips.text: Twenty-four square meters of somebody else's bad decisions. Two double beds jammed side by side, a kitchenette that smells of old soy, and a ceiling fan that has given up. This is home until Sunday.

clips.label: Euphoria: do you know who I am?
clips.text: Do you have any idea who I am?

clips.label: Euphoria: get your hands off me
clips.text: Get your hands off me!

clips.label: Euphoria: my people will find me
clips.text: My people will find me. You know that, right? Every single one of you is finished.

clips.label: Euphoria: fine, but I want my own room
clips.text: Fine. Fine! But I want my own room. And real coffee, not that soy drek.

clips.label: Euphoria: this is not a hotel
clips.text: This is not a hotel. This is not even a closet. I have closets bigger than this.

clips.label: Euphoria: let's make a deal
clips.text: Okay. Whoever's paying you, I'll pay double. My manager will transfer it tonight. Just take me home.

clips.label: Diablo: payday
clips.text: First half's on its way, chummers. Nice work. Keep her comfortable and keep your heads down.

clips.label: Diablo: you moved?
clips.text: You moved? Smart. Tell me where, and I'll bring the rest of your money. Nobody else, chummer. Nobody.

clips.label: SFX: door kicked in
clips.sfx: A cheap apartment door being kicked in, wood splintering, followed by shouting

clips.label: Pride: the door
clips.text: Good afternoon. I believe you have something that belongs to my client.

clips.label: Pride: walk away
clips.text: You have courage. I respect that. Give me the girl, and you may walk away. This offer is made once.

clips.label: Pride: angered
clips.text: Enough! You have made your choice. Now the lion feeds.

clips.label: Pride: withdraw
clips.text: Another day, little runners. The hunt is never over.

clips.label: Whitecastle: the call
clips.text: Good to see you, chummer. I've got a client with deep pockets and a very public problem. Pays well, and the meet's tonight.

clips.label: Whitecastle: asked for you
clips.text: Funny thing. The client asked for your team by name. Don't ask me how they know you.

clips.label: Carrone: let's not waste time
clips.text: Let's not waste each other's time. Euphoria is missing again, MegaMedia wants her back, and I'm told you're discreet.

clips.label: Carrone: name your price
clips.text: Find her, quietly, before the press does. Name your price, within reason.

clips.label: Carrone: I know what you did
clips.text: I know exactly who took her the first time. The only question is whether you're going to be useful to me now.

clips.label: Carrone: don't disappoint me
clips.text: MegaMedia has a long memory and a very large legal department. Don't disappoint me.

clips.label: Read-aloud: the condo
clips.text: The penthouse door is open. Inside, the air is thick with something sharp and chemical, like vinegar left to rot. The bodyguards are still here. Most of them. Whatever did this did not use a gun.

clips.label: Read-aloud: the sim recording
clips.text: The playback takes you behind her eyes. Music, a mirror, a smile practiced a thousand times. Then glass bursts inward, and something with too many limbs fills the frame. You feel her scream in your own throat.

clips.label: Burroughs: nothing to do with me
clips.text: I don't know what you think you've found, but it has nothing to do with me. Strice Foods runs a clean operation.

clips.label: Burroughs: he made me
clips.text: You don't understand. He has things on me. He said he'd ruin me. He said nobody would get hurt.

clips.label: Burroughs: calling Lone Star
clips.text: Security! Get Lone Star on the line, there's an intrusion in the system!

clips.label: SFX: paparazzi flashes
clips.sfx: A crowd of photographers shouting and camera shutters clicking rapidly outside a building

clips.label: SFX: shop door chime
clips.sfx: An old shop door opening with a small brass bell, creaking floorboards

clips.label: Craft: welcome
clips.text: Welcome, welcome! Fetishes, foci, the finest reagents in the Barrens. Whatever you seek, friends, I can find it for you.

clips.label: Craft: she's resting
clips.text: Euphoria? No, no, she's resting now. She's changing. She'll be so much more than she was.

clips.label: Craft: you shouldn't have come
clips.text: You shouldn't have come here. You can feel them, can't you? Under the floor. Waiting.

clips.label: Craft: the Queen calls
clips.text: No. No! The Queen is calling. I won't let you take her from me!

playlists.name: QE Soundboard — Act 2: Audience with the Queen

clips.label: SFX: the Hive (loop)
clips.sfx: Dark underground insect hive ambience, constant low chittering and clicking of thousands of insects, wet organic sounds, faint dripping

clips.label: SFX: worker screech
clips.sfx: A shrill alarm screech from a giant insect, half human and half insect, echoing in a tunnel

clips.label: SFX: soldier through the wall
clips.sfx: A heavy insect smashing through a plaster and drywall partition, crunching debris and chittering

clips.label: Read-aloud: going down
clips.text: The stairwell breathes. Warm, damp air rises from below, carrying a sound you feel in your teeth before you hear it: thousands of tiny legs, moving together.

clips.label: Read-aloud: the Hive Room
clips.text: At the heart of the nest hangs a cocoon the size of a person, glistening and pulsing. Through its thinning skin you can make out a face you know from a hundred magazine covers. She is still breathing.

clips.label: Craft: you came for the coronation
clips.text: You came! You came to see her crowned. Isn't she beautiful? Isn't she perfect?

clips.label: Craft: the Mother
clips.text: The Mother speaks through me now. Every one of you will serve her. Every one of you will feed the Hive.

clips.label: Craft: no!
clips.text: Get away from her! Children, protect your Queen! Tear them apart!

clips.label: Euphoria: help me
clips.text: Please. Please, get me out. I can hear them. I can hear them inside my head.
